描述_EN: the result is not particularly striking, as the brown splashes do not contrast sharply with the dark brown glaze. nevertheless it inspired later potters to improve on the glaze recipe to produce a russet on brown colour scheme. this jar is an early example of glaze manipulation for decorative effect.
描述_ZN: 结果不是特别引人注目，因为棕色的飞溅物与深棕色的釉面没有形成鲜明的对比。 尽管如此，它启发了后来的陶艺家在釉料配方上进行改进，以产生棕色上的赤褐色色彩方案。 这个罐子是一个早期的装饰效果的釉面操作的例子。
